intro: Paragon tiers are for boss events, where Paragons do most of the late damage. They come from the Bloons wiki's boss-event guide and boss strategy pages; costs are Medium difficulty.

paragons.name: Goliath Doomship
paragons.summary: Named among the highest-damage Paragons in the boss-event guide.

paragons.name: Magus Perfectus
paragons.summary: Mana-driven damage Paragon combining Archmage, Phoenix and Necromancer; huge burst during Arcane Metamorphosis.
strengths: Very high damage with its big abilities

paragons.name: Mega Massive Munitions Factory
paragons.summary: Named among the highest-damage Paragons in the boss-event guide.
weaknesses: Short range: poor direct damage against Phayze
Lych can steal Controlled Burst at tier 5

paragons.name: Nautic Siege Core
paragons.summary: A stall-safe pick that can handle later Phayze and Vortex tiers alone or in pairs.
strengths: Safe when you need to stall

paragons.name: Master Builder
paragons.summary: Power Glove overclocks other Paragons; Mega Sentries add burst; its nailgun stuns blimps.
weaknesses: Power Glove doesn't stack with Overclock

paragons.name: Ascended Shadow
paragons.summary: Recommended against Phayze and Vortex; gives Crucible its camo detection.
weaknesses: Loses its anti-camo bonus if you also use decamo towers

paragons.name: Navarch of the Seas
paragons.summary: Water Paragon recommended against Lych and Phayze; the boss guide plans it around 40 Merchantmen.
weaknesses: Avoid when you need to stall rounds or let other towers get pops

paragons.name: Herald of Everfrost
paragons.summary: A stall-safe support Paragon that also cools Blastapopoulos.

paragons.name: Apex Plasma Master
paragons.summary: The cheapest Paragon; a good option against tier 3–4 bosses.
weaknesses: Avoid against Elite bosses unless conditions favour it

paragons.name: Crucible of Steel and Flame
paragons.summary: Second-cheapest Paragon; Meteor Impact burst and a Maelstrom flame ring.
weaknesses: Poor against Phayze; Lych steals Maelstrom
Avoid against Elite bosses unless conditions favour it

paragons.name: Glaive Dominus
paragons.summary: Listed for Lych and later Bloonarius tiers; the boss guide doesn't single it out.

paragons.name: Ballistic Obliteration Missile Bunker
paragons.summary: The wiki's boss guides don't recommend it specifically.
weaknesses: Not featured in the boss guides we cite

paragons.name: Root of all Nature
paragons.summary: The newest pre-v57 Paragon (v54); not yet covered by the boss guides.
weaknesses: Not featured in the boss guides we cite

paragons.name: S.P.I.D.E.R. Monkey
paragons.summary: Sniper Paragon added in v57: bouncing heavy shots with shrapnel, a Cash Drop barrage, an Offensive Supply Drop, an area buff and a charge shot.
weaknesses: Too new to rank: placeholder tier

basics: Unlock the Paragon with tower XP (500,000–1,000,000) after every other upgrade of that tower.
Have all three tier-5 versions of the tower on the map, then upgrade one of them. Only one of each Paragon can exist; boss events usually cap you at 4.
Degree runs 1–100 and needs 200,000 power for degree 100. Each degree costs more than the last.

powerSources.source: Cash spent on absorbed towers (and the slider)
Extra tier 5s beyond the three you need
Pops and income of absorbed towers

tips: Aim for multiples of 20: boss damage jumps at degree 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100, so 19 → 20 matters more than 20 → 21.
Several mid-degree Paragons usually beat one maxed Paragon, because each degree costs more than the last.
Spend cash on real towers before the slider; the slider gives slightly less power per dollar.
Farm pops with income towers: XXXL Trap, Rubber to Gold, Monkey City and Bounty Hunter supply most of the damage/income power.
Overclock and Ultraboost your Banana Farms while farming power.
Three Paragon Power Totems equal one extra tier 5.
If you'll sell it later, upgrade the most expensive of the three tier 5s.
Four Paragons at degree 40+ handle nearly every boss, including Elite.
degreeGuide.degree100: At degree 100, damage and pierce double (+10 flat each) and the boss damage multiplier reaches ×2.25 (Normal) / ×4.5 (Elite).
degreeGuide.note: Power values come from the wiki's Paragon page (pre-v57) with the cap changes from the v57.0 notes applied. With the new caps, the non-totem sources add up to 255,000, more than the 200,000 needed, so degree 100 may now be reachable solo without totems; this is our arithmetic, not a tested result.
